# ORVUM

> ORVUM is an AI-native retail operating system in development: one intelligence layer intended to connect buying, purchase orders, receiving, inventory, POS/mPOS, sales, returns, clienteling, finance, analytics and owner decision support. It is designed for retailers and the brands they work with, from independent stores to multi-store retail groups. ORVUM is based in Cyprus. Its founder, Ilya Loshak, has a background in premium multi-brand retail.

Status: in development. Prototypes and product designs shown on the website are illustrative and are not released functionality. ORVUM does not publish customer, revenue or ROI figures.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.orvum.com/): what ORVUM is and the modules it is designed to connect
- [Platform](https://www.orvum.com/platform): scope, design principles and development status
- [About](https://www.orvum.com/about): the company and its founder
- [Contact](https://www.orvum.com/contact): how to reach ORVUM
- [Retail calculators](https://www.orvum.com/tools): free open-to-buy and sell-through calculators that run in the browser
- [Retail metrics glossary](https://www.orvum.com/glossary): open-to-buy, sell-through rate, GMROI, weeks of supply, inventory turnover, clienteling
